```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) {
  library(neuro2)
}

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Standard column order
standard_col_order <- c(
  "scale",
  "raw_score",
  "score",
  "ci_95",
  "percentile",
  "range",
  "test",
  "test_name",
  "domain",
  "subdomain",
  "narrow",
  "pass",
  "verbal",
  "timed",
  "test_type",
  "score_type",
  "absort",
  "description",
  "result"
)

# Scale definitions for CVLT-3 Brief (from lookup table)
cvlt3_brief_scales <- list(
  # Table 1: Learning Trials
  learning = c(
    "Trial 1 Correct",
    "Trial 2 Correct",
    "Trial 3 Correct",
    "Trial 4 Correct"
  ),
  # Table 2: Immediate Recall Total
  immediate = c("Trials 1-4 Correct"),
  # Table 3: Delayed Recall
  delayed = c(
    "Short Delay Free Recall",
    "Long Delay Free Recall",
    "Long Delay Cued Recall"
  ),
  # Table 4: Recognition
  recognition = c(
    "Total Hits",
    "Total False Positives",
    "Recognition Discriminability (d')",
    "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric"
  ),
  # Table 5: Intrusions
  intrusions = c("Total Intrusions"),
  # Table 6: Repetitions
  repetitions = c("Total Repetitions"),
  # Table 7: Forced-Choice (Validity)
  forced_choice = c("CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits")
)

# Scale definitions for CVLT-3 Full
cvlt3_full_scales <- list(
  learning = c(
    "Trial 1 Correct",
    "Trial 2 Correct",
    "Trial 3 Correct",
    "Trial 4 Correct",
    "Trial 5 Correct",
    "List B Correct"
  ),
  immediate = c("Trials 1-5 Correct"),
  delayed = c(
    "Short Delay Free Recall",
    "Short Delay Cued Recall",
    "Long Delay Free Recall",
    "Long Delay Cued Recall"
  ),
  recognition = c(
    "Total Hits",
    "Total False Positives",
    "Recognition Discriminability (d')",
    "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric"
  ),
  intrusions = c("Total Intrusions"),
  repetitions = c("Total Repetitions"),
  forced_choice = c("CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits")
)

# Predefined extraction areas (from Rmd file)
cvlt3_brief_areas <- list(
  c(166, 52, 237, 560), # Table 1: Learning Trials
  c(159, 52, 185, 560), # Table 2: Immediate Recall
  c(289, 52, 343, 560), # Table 3: Delayed Recall
  c(397, 52, 467, 560), # Table 4: Recognition
  c(520, 52, 544, 560), # Table 5: Intrusions
  c(273, 52, 296, 560), # Table 6: Repetitions
  c(597, 52, 619, 459) # Table 7: Forced-Choice
)

cvlt3_full_areas <- list(
  c(166, 52, 265, 560), # Table 1
  c(159, 52, 185, 560), # Table 2
  c(320, 52, 390, 560), # Table 3
  c(445, 52, 514, 560), # Table 4
  c(571, 52, 590, 560), # Table 5
  c(570, 52, 589, 560), # Table 6
  c(646, 52, 665, 460) # Table 7
)

# Default pages for each table
cvlt3_brief_pages <- c(13, 15, 13, 13, 13, 16, 13)
cvlt3_full_pages <- c(18, 20, 18, 18, 18, 22, 18)

# Load lookup table
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("cvlt3", test))
} else {
  lookup_table <- NULL
}

# Scale name normalization (Rmd names -> Lookup names)
normalize_scale_name <- function(scale_name) {
  # Add "Correct" suffix for delayed recall scales if missing
  if (grepl("Delay.*Recall$", scale_name) && !grepl("Correct$", scale_name)) {
    return(paste0(scale_name, " Correct"))
  }
  scale_name
}
```

## CVLT-3 / CVLT-3 Brief Memory Test

This extractor handles the multi-table structure of CVLT-3 reports:

- **Tables 1-6**: Learning trials, immediate/delayed recall, recognition, errors (scaled scores)
- **Table 7**: Forced-choice recognition (validity indicator, raw score)

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

selectInput(
  "test_version",
  "Test Version",
  choices = c("CVLT-3 Brief" = "cvlt3_brief", "CVLT-3 Full" = "cvlt3"),
  selected = "cvlt3_brief"
)

hr()
fileInput("file", "Upload CVLT-3 PDF", accept = ".pdf")

hr()
h5("Page Numbers for Each Table")
helpText("Adjust pages based on your PDF layout")

fluidRow(
  column(6, numericInput("page1", "Learning Trials:", value = 13, min = 1)),
  column(6, numericInput("page2", "Immediate Recall:", value = 15, min = 1))
)
fluidRow(
  column(6, numericInput("page3", "Delayed Recall:", value = 13, min = 1)),
  column(6, numericInput("page4", "Recognition:", value = 13, min = 1))
)
fluidRow(
  column(6, numericInput("page5", "Intrusions:", value = 13, min = 1)),
  column(6, numericInput("page6", "Repetitions:", value = 16, min = 1))
)
numericInput("page7", "Forced-Choice:", value = 13, min = 1)

hr()
checkboxInput("use_areas", "Use predefined areas", value = TRUE)
selectInput(
  "method",
  "Extraction Method",
  choices = c("stream", "lattice"),
  selected = "stream"
)

hr()
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract All Tables", class = "btn-success btn-lg")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Get current test config
current_scales <- reactive({
  if (input$test_version == "cvlt3_brief") {
    cvlt3_brief_scales
  } else {
    cvlt3_full_scales
  }
})

current_areas <- reactive({
  if (input$test_version == "cvlt3_brief") {
    cvlt3_brief_areas
  } else {
    cvlt3_full_areas
  }
})

get_test_name <- reactive({
  if (input$test_version == "cvlt3_brief") "CVLT-3 Brief" else "CVLT-3"
})

output$version_info_ui <- renderUI({
  wellPanel(
    h5(get_test_name()),
    tags$small(
      "Domain: Memory | Score Type: Scaled Score | Test Type: npsych_test"
    ),
    tags$br(),
    tags$small(
      "Table 7 (Forced-Choice) is a validity indicator with raw scores"
    )
  )
})

# Get pages as vector
get_pages <- reactive({
  c(
    input$page1,
    input$page2,
    input$page3,
    input$page4,
    input$page5,
    input$page6,
    input$page7
  )
})

# Extract all tables
extracted_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)

  pages <- get_pages()
  areas <- current_areas()

  withProgress(message = "Extracting 7 tables...", value = 0, {
    tables <- list()

    for (i in 1:7) {
      incProgress(1 / 7, detail = paste("Table", i))

      tryCatch(
        {
          if (input$use_areas) {
            # Use predefined areas
            result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
              file = input$file$datapath,
              pages = pages[i],
              area = list(areas[[i]]),
              method = input$method,
              guess = FALSE,
              output = "matrix"
            )
          } else {
            # Auto-detect
            result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
              file = input$file$datapath,
              pages = pages[i],
              method = input$method,
              guess = TRUE,
              output = "matrix"
            )
          }

          if (length(result) > 0) {
            df <- as.data.frame(result[[1]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
            df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
            colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
            tables[[i]] <- df
          } else {
            tables[[i]] <- NULL
          }
        },
        error = function(e) {
          tables[[i]] <- NULL
        }
      )
    }

    tables
  })
})

# Create mapping UI for each table
create_mapping_ui <- function(table_num, scales, is_forced_choice = FALSE) {
  renderUI({
    tables <- extracted_tables()
    req(tables)

    df <- tables[[table_num]]
    if (is.null(df)) {
      return(helpText(paste("No data extracted for Table", table_num)))
    }

    cols <- colnames(df)
    make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
      setNames(
        cols,
        sapply(cols, function(c) {
          preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 2), collapse = ", ")
          paste0(c, " (", substr(preview, 1, 20), ")")
        })
      )
    }
    choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
    none <- c("None" = "None")

    if (is_forced_choice) {
      # Table 7: raw_score, base_rate columns
      wellPanel(
        h6(paste("Table", table_num, "Mapping")),
        fluidRow(
          column(
            4,
            selectInput(
              paste0("col_raw_", table_num),
              "Raw Score:",
              choices = c(none, choices),
              selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None"
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            selectInput(
              paste0("col_base_", table_num),
              "Base Rate:",
              choices = c(none, choices),
              selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else "None"
            )
          )
        ),
        helpText(paste("Expected scales:", paste(scales, collapse = ", ")))
      )
    } else {
      # Tables 1-6: raw_score, score, percentile
      wellPanel(
        h6(paste("Table", table_num, "Mapping")),
        fluidRow(
          column(
            3,
            selectInput(
              paste0("col_raw_", table_num),
              "Raw Score:",
              choices = c(none, choices),
              selected = if (length(cols) >= 2) cols[2] else "None"
            )
          ),
          column(
            3,
            selectInput(
              paste0("col_score_", table_num),
              "Scaled Score:",
              choices = c(none, choices),
              selected = if (length(cols) >= 3) cols[3] else "None"
            )
          ),
          column(
            3,
            selectInput(
              paste0("col_pct_", table_num),
              "Percentile:",
              choices = c(none, choices),
              selected = if (length(cols) >= 4) cols[4] else "None"
            )
          )
        ),
        helpText(paste("Expected scales:", paste(scales, collapse = ", ")))
      )
    }
  })
}

# Generate mapping UIs
output$mapping1_ui <- create_mapping_ui(1, current_scales()$learning)
output$mapping2_ui <- create_mapping_ui(2, current_scales()$immediate)
output$mapping3_ui <- create_mapping_ui(3, current_scales()$delayed)
output$mapping4_ui <- create_mapping_ui(4, current_scales()$recognition)
output$mapping5_ui <- create_mapping_ui(5, current_scales()$intrusions)
output$mapping6_ui <- create_mapping_ui(6, current_scales()$repetitions)
output$mapping7_ui <- create_mapping_ui(
  7,
  current_scales()$forced_choice,
  is_forced_choice = TRUE
)

# Preview tables
output$table1_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[1]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table2_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[2]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table3_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[3]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table4_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[4]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table5_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[5]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table6_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[6]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})
output$table7_preview <- renderDT({
  req(extracted_tables())
  datatable(
    extracted_tables()[[7]],
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5)
  )
})

# Process individual table (Tables 1-6)
process_standard_table <- function(table_num, scale_names, subdomain, narrow) {
  tables <- extracted_tables()
  if (is.null(tables[[table_num]])) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- tables[[table_num]]
  n_scales <- length(scale_names)

  # Get column inputs
  col_raw <- input[[paste0("col_raw_", table_num)]]
  col_score <- input[[paste0("col_score_", table_num)]]
  col_pct <- input[[paste0("col_pct_", table_num)]]

  # Build result - use first n_scales rows
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = scale_names[1:min(n_scales, nrow(df))],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.null(col_raw) && col_raw != "None" && col_raw %in% names(df)) {
    result$raw_score <- safe_numeric(df[[col_raw]][1:nrow(result)])
  }
  if (!is.null(col_score) && col_score != "None" && col_score %in% names(df)) {
    result$score <- safe_numeric(df[[col_score]][1:nrow(result)])
  }
  if (!is.null(col_pct) && col_pct != "None" && col_pct %in% names(df)) {
    result$percentile <- safe_numeric(df[[col_pct]][1:nrow(result)])
  }

  # Add metadata
  result$test <- input$test_version
  result$test_name <- get_test_name()
  result$domain <- "Memory"
  result$subdomain <- subdomain
  result$narrow <- narrow
  result$pass <- "Sequential"
  result$verbal <- "Verbal"
  result$timed <- "Untimed"
  result$test_type <- "npsych_test"
  result$score_type <- "scaled_score"
  result$ci_95 <- NA_character_
  result$range <- NA_character_

  result
}

# Process Table 7 (Forced-Choice)
process_forced_choice <- function() {
  tables <- extracted_tables()
  if (is.null(tables[[7]])) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- tables[[7]]
  scale_names <- current_scales()$forced_choice

  col_raw <- input$col_raw_7
  col_base <- input$col_base_7

  result <- data.frame(
    scale = scale_names[1:min(length(scale_names), nrow(df))],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.null(col_raw) && col_raw != "None" && col_raw %in% names(df)) {
    result$raw_score <- safe_numeric(df[[col_raw]][1:nrow(result)])
  }

  # For forced-choice, percentile is typically set to 50 (pass/fail)
  result$score <- NA_integer_
  result$percentile <- 50

  result$test <- input$test_version
  result$test_name <- get_test_name()
  result$domain <- "Validity"
  result$subdomain <- "Performance Validity"
  result$narrow <- "Effort"
  result$pass <- "Attention"
  result$verbal <- "Verbal"
  result$timed <- "Untimed"
  result$test_type <- "validity_indicator"
  result$score_type <- "raw_score"
  result$ci_95 <- NA_character_
  result$range <- NA_character_

  result
}

# Combined processed data
processed_data <- reactive({
  req(extracted_tables())

  scales <- current_scales()

  # Process each table with appropriate metadata
  t1 <- process_standard_table(
    1,
    scales$learning,
    "Learning Efficiency",
    "Word-List Learning"
  )
  t2 <- process_standard_table(
    2,
    scales$immediate,
    "Learning Efficiency",
    "Word-List Learning"
  )
  t3 <- process_standard_table(
    3,
    scales$delayed,
    "Delayed Recall",
    "Free-Recall Memory"
  )
  t4 <- process_standard_table(
    4,
    scales$recognition,
    "Delayed Recall",
    "Recognition Memory"
  )
  t5 <- process_standard_table(
    5,
    scales$intrusions,
    "Attention",
    "Response Monitoring"
  )
  t6 <- process_standard_table(
    6,
    scales$repetitions,
    "Attention",
    "Response Monitoring"
  )
  t7 <- process_forced_choice()

  # Update domain for error tables
  if (!is.null(t5)) {
    t5$domain <- "Attention/Executive"
  }
  if (!is.null(t6)) {
    t6$domain <- "Attention/Executive"
  }

  # Combine all tables
  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, t6, t7)

  if (nrow(combined) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Join with lookup table for absort and description
  if (!is.null(lookup_table) && nrow(lookup_table) > 0) {
    # Normalize scale names for joining
    combined <- combined |>
      dplyr::mutate(scale_lookup = sapply(scale, normalize_scale_name))

    lookup_cols <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::filter(test == input$test_version) |>
      dplyr::select(scale, absort, description) |>
      dplyr::distinct()

    if (nrow(lookup_cols) > 0) {
      combined <- combined |>
        dplyr::left_join(lookup_cols, by = c("scale_lookup" = "scale")) |>
        dplyr::select(-scale_lookup)
    }
  }

  # Add missing columns
  if (!"absort" %in% names(combined)) {
    combined$absort <- NA_character_
  }
  if (!"description" %in% names(combined)) {
    combined$description <- NA_character_
  }
  if (!"result" %in% names(combined)) {
    combined$result <- NA_character_
  }

  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (
    neuro2_available &&
      exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))
  ) {
    combined <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(
      combined,
      test_type = "npsych_test"
    )
  }

  # Create result text
  combined <- combined |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      result = ifelse(
        !is.na(description) & !is.na(range),
        paste0(description, " was ", range, "."),
        NA_character_
      )
    )

  # Reorder columns
  combined |> dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
})

output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(extracted_tables())) {
    return("Upload PDF and click 'Extract All Tables'")
  }

  n_extracted <- sum(!sapply(extracted_tables(), is.null))
  n_rows <- if (!is.null(processed_data())) nrow(processed_data()) else 0

  paste0("✓ Extracted ", n_extracted, "/7 tables | ", n_rows, " total records")
})

output$combined_table <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(
    processed_data(),
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0(input$test_version, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```
